mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_issuance_events WHERE event_id = #{eventId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_issuance_events (event_id, ci_hash, card_reference_id, issuer_product_code, card_last4, card_type, card_status, processing_status, received_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{ciHash}, #{cardReferenceId}, #{issuerProductCode}, #{cardLast4}, #{cardType}, #{cardStatus}, 'RECEIVED', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE card_issuance_events SET processing_status = 'PROCESSED', processed_at = NOW(), fail_reason = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
